found: Writing %d of %d found, over all your runs.

legend.right: on a wall: step up to read it

warm.title: IN WICK'S HAND
warm.text: Lit every torch again. They watch who comes down, and remember the kind ones.

wary.title: SCRATCHED BY THE STAIR
wary.text: The halls moved while I slept. Same stones, new turns. Nobody else was surprised.

cold.title: CARVED DEEP
cold.text: The Hoard threw me down for a cup of gold. Six dead since. Which of us is the thief?

warm.title: A TALLY, CROSSED OUT
warm.text: Someone struck out the tally and wrote: these sat with me instead. Count those.

wary.title: A TALLY
wary.text: Everyone the Hoard threw down. The oldest marks are in a hand a lot like yours.

cold.title: A FRESH TALLY
cold.text: The newest marks are still wet, cut with an edge just like the one you carry.

warm.title: A BURROW SCRAWL
warm.text: Drawn in slime for the young: the way the gentle one walked. It's the way you came.

wary.title: A CREW LEDGER
wary.text: Paid ASHKA forty to look away. Paid the Coil twenty. The halls take the rest.

cold.title: OLD STONE, SPLIT
cold.text: The Old Stone carved a name for each of its own you broke. It ran out of wall.

warm.title: UNDER THE FLOOR
warm.text: The breathing below slows as you pass, like something listening for company.

wary.title: A WARNING
wary.text: When the Door stays shut, the halls fold up and the thief wakes on B1F again.

cold.title: WHAT THE DOOR SAYS
cold.text: Alone again. Fold the halls. Throw them back to the top. Let them try once more.

warm.title: ON THE LAST DOOR
warm.text: Names under the soot, two by two. Nobody who walked out of here walked out alone.

wary.title: VEXALITH'S CLAW
wary.text: I made the Door to keep my gold. It opens only for two. I never had a second.

cold.title: BEHIND THE DOOR
cold.text: Every thief who came down alone is still here, folded into the walls.
